DC sealed sleeve axial fans provide a general purpose, compact and reliable solution to a variety of applications. The sealed sleeve technology provides a cost-effective alternative to ball bearing fans, with a longer life expectancy than standard sleeve bearing fans. All models are highly reliable and excellent quality.
